segments.he:
צדיק האמת מלקט ניצו״ק

״וַיְלַקֵּט יוֹסֵף אֶת כָּל הַכֶּסֶף״ וגו׳

(מז, יד)

הַצַּדִּיק אֱמֶת עוֹסְקִים בָּזֶה לְלַקֵּט לִקּוּטִים שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת נִיצוֹצוֹת קְדוֹשִׁים הַמִּתְבָּרְרִים בְּכָל עֵת עַל יְדֵי כָּל נְקֻדָּה וּנְקֻדָּה טוֹבָה שֶׁל כָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל. שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת וַיְלַקֵּט יוֹסֵף אֶת כָּל הַכֶּסֶף וְכוּ׳.

כִּי עִקַּר הַגְּאֻלָּה תְּלוּיָה בָּזֶה לְבָרֵר כָּל נִיצוֹצוֹת הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁנָּפְלוּ עַל יְדֵי שְׁבִירַת כֵּלִים כַּיָּדוּעַ קמה. אֲבָל אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְבָרְרָם כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי אִתְעָרוּתָא דִּלְתַתָּא וְכוּ׳, וְכַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. וּבִשְׁבִיל זֶה אֲרִיכַת הַגָּלוּת כָּל כָּךְ, כִּי הַבַּעַל דָּבָר מִתְפַּשֵּׁט בְּכָל עֵת לְאֹרֶךְ וּלְרֹחַב בִּכְלָל וּבִפְרָט. וּבְיוֹתֵר כָּל מַה שֶׁרוֹאֶה שֶׁאֶחָד רוֹצֶה לְהִתְקָרֵב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְכוּ׳.

אֲבָל הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת הוּא בְּחִינַת יָשִׂישׂ כְּגִבּוֹר לָרוּץ אֹרַח וְכוּ׳ כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר שָׁם, וְכָל הִתְגַּבְּרוּתוֹ הִיא רַק עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת וְהוּא כְּחָתָן יוֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ, שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל יוֹצֵא מֵחָכְמוֹת חִיצוֹנִיּוֹת וּמִמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת רָעוֹת וְהִרְהוּרִים רָעִים וְכוּ׳ כַּמּוּבָן שָׁם בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַנִּזְכֶּרֶת לְעֵיל. אֲבָל הוּא סוֹבֵל מַרְעִין וְיִסּוּרִים רַבִּים מֵאִתָּנוּ בִּבְחִינַת וְהוּא מְחֹלָל מִפְּשָׁעֵינוּ וְכוּ׳, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁבְּכָל פַּעַם שֶׁאֶחָד מִתְעוֹרֵר מְעַט לָשׁוּב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ תֵּכֶף מִתְגַּבְּרִין עָלָיו וְכוּ׳, וְהוּא אֵינוֹ מִתְגַּבֵּר כָּרָאוּי וְכוּ׳, כַּיָּדוּעַ כָּל זֶה מַה שֶׁעוֹבֵר עַל כָּל אֶחָד.

אֲבָל הָעִקַּר הוּא הַהִתְחַזְּקוּת בְּכֹחַ הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לֵידַע שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק הוּא גִּבּוֹר כֹּחַ כָּזֶה שֶׁכָּל נְקֻדָּה וּנְקֻדָּה טוֹבָה שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר כָּל אֶחָד בְּאֵיזֶה רֶגַע, הוּא חוֹטֵף אוֹתָהּ מִיָּד וּמַכְנִיסָהּ לְתוֹךְ בֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהוּא בּוֹנֶה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מִשְׁכָּן וּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת בֵּיתָא תַּתָּאָה וְכוּ׳ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. וְעַל כֵּן אֲפִלּוּ כְּשֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ יוֹרֵד כְּמוֹ שֶׁיּוֹרֵד זֶה שֶׁרָצָה לְהִתְקָרֵב, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אֵינוֹ נֶאֱבָד הַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת הַמְּעַט שֶׁלּוֹ, כִּי כְּבָר נִכְנַס לְתוֹךְ בִּנְיַן בֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק בְּבִנְיָנוֹ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל.

כל אחד צריך להתחזק לא להניח מקומו

עַל כֵּן צָרִיךְ כָּל אֶחָד לִבְלִי לְהַנִּיחַ אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן בִּבְחִינַת מְקוֹמְךָ אַל תַּנַּח, וּבְכָל פַּעַם שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר עַל מַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ הָרָעָה וּמְנַשֵּׂא עַצְמוֹ לַחֲשֹׁב מַחֲשָׁבוֹת טוֹבוֹת וּמִתְגַּעְגֵּעַ וְכוֹסֵף לְהִתְקָרֵב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ לֵית רְעוּתָא טָבָא דְּאִתְאַבַּד, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מַה שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה בְּכָל פַּעַם אֵיזֶה דָּבָר שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה, כִּי הֲלֹא אֲפִלּוּ פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מְלֵאִים מִצְווֹת כְּרִמּוֹן וְכוּ׳.

(וְכַמְּבֹאָר בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה מִזֶּה וּבִפְרָט עַל פָּסוּק אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹקַי בְּעוֹדִי וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהִזְהִיר הוּא זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה לֵילֵךְ עִם זֶה מְאֹד).

וְהָעִקַּר הוּא כֹּחַ הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁעוֹסֵק בְּתִקּוּן הָעוֹלָמוֹת עַל יְדֵי תִּקּוּן נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמְּקַבֵּץ וּמְלַקֵּט בְּכָל עֵת וָרֶגַע כָּל מַחֲשָׁבָה וּמַחֲשָׁבָה טוֹבָה וְכָל דִּבּוּר וּמַעֲשֶׂה טוֹב וּמַכְנִיס אוֹתָם תֵּכֶף לְתוֹךְ בֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה וְכוּ׳ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל, עַד שֶׁמִּתְקַבְּצִים וּמִתְלַקְּטִים כָּל הַנְּקֻדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת שֶׁל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד, עַד שֶׁיֵּשׁ לְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד חֵלֶק גָּדוֹל בְּבִנְיַן הַבֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה מִתְבָּרְרִים הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת וְנַעֲשִׂים כֵּלִים לְקַבֵּל הָאוֹר אֵין סוֹף שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּלֵב כָּל אֶחָד בְּכָל יוֹם עַד שֶׁסּוֹף כָּל סוֹף יָשׁוּבוּ הַכֹּל אֶל ה׳.

וְזֶה בְּחִינַת אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ שֶׁנִּסְמַךְ לְפָסוּק אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עֹז לוֹ בָךְ. כִּי עִקַּר הָעֹז וְהַהִתְחַזְּקוּת לֶאֱחֹז עַצְמוֹ בַּה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא, הוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה לִהְיוֹת בִּכְלַל יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת בֵּיתָא עִלָּאָה וּבֵיתָא תַּתָּאָה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק בְּבִנְיָנָם כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה עִקַּר הַהִתְחַזְּקוּת, שֶׁעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עֹז לוֹ בָךְ, אַשְׁרֵי בְּוַדַּאי כִּי זֶה הָעִקַּר כַּיָּדוּעַ. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה עִקַּר הַמְשָׁכַת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק מַמְשִׁיךְ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל דּוֹר שֶׁהָעִקַּר עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת לִקּוּטִים אֵלּוּ. וְכַמּוּבָן בְּתוֹרָה אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם הַשְׁגָּחָה (סימן יג לקוטי חלק א) בְּחִינַת וְלֹקֵחַ נְפָשׁוֹת חָכָם וְכוּ׳. בְּחִינַת אָרִיתִי מוֹרִי עִם בְּשָׂמִי וְכוּ׳. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה עִיר גִּבֹּרִים עָלָה חָכָם וַיֵּרֶד עֹז מִבְטֶחָה.

(הלכות מתנה הלכה ד׳ אות ס״ג)
segments.en:
The true righteous man gathers holy sparks.

“And Joseph gathered all the silver,” etc.

(47:14)

The true righteous man occupies himself with this: gathering collections which are the aspect of holy sparks that are refined at every time through every single good point of every single one of Israel. This is the aspect of “And Joseph gathered all the silver,” etc.

For the essence of the redemption depends on this: refining all the holy sparks that fell through the shattering of vessels, as is known [printed note marker: קמה]. But it is impossible to refine them except through an awakening from below, etc., and as mentioned above. And for this reason the exile is so prolonged, because the adversary spreads out at every time lengthwise and breadthwise, in general and in particular. And all the more so, whenever he sees that someone wishes to draw near to the Lord, blessed be He, etc.

But the true righteous man is the aspect of “He rejoices like a mighty man to run a course,” etc., as explained there; and all his prevailing is only through the aspect of “And he is like a bridegroom coming out of his canopy”—which is through each one of Israel coming out of external wisdoms and out of evil thoughts and evil contemplations, etc., as understood there in the aforementioned Torah teaching. But he suffers ailments and many afflictions from us, in the aspect of “And he is wounded because of our transgressions,” etc., because each time someone awakens a little to return to the Lord, blessed be He, immediately they prevail against him, etc., and he does not prevail as he ought, etc.; as is known, all this is what passes over each one.

But the essential thing is strengthening oneself through the power of the righteous man: one must know that the righteous man is so mighty in power that every single good point in which each one prevails at some moment—he snatches it at once and brings it into the house of holiness that he is building, which is the aspect of the Tabernacle and the Temple, which is the aspect of the lower house, etc., as mentioned above. And therefore, even when afterward the one who wished to draw near descends as he descends, nevertheless his little awakening is not lost, because it has already entered into the building of the house of holiness whose building the righteous man is engaged in, as mentioned above.

Each one must strengthen himself not to abandon his place.

Therefore each one must not abandon his place in any manner, in the aspect of “Do not leave your place”; and each time he prevails over his evil thought and lifts himself up to think good thoughts, and yearns and longs to draw near to the Lord, blessed be He—“No good will is lost.” All the more so, whatever holy thing he does each time; for indeed, even the sinners of Israel are full of commandments like a pomegranate, etc.

(And as explained extensively about this in our words, and particularly concerning the verse “I will sing to my God while I yet am,” etc., which he, of blessed memory, warned one to walk with very much).

And the essential thing is the power of the righteous man, who is engaged in the repair of the worlds through the repair of the souls of Israel; this is through his gathering and collecting, at every time and moment, every single good thought and every good utterance and deed, and bringing them immediately into the house of holiness, etc., as mentioned above, until all the good points of each and every one are gathered and collected, until each and every one has a large share in the building of the house of holiness, through which the sparks are refined and vessels are made to receive the light of the Infinite, which shines in the heart of each one every day, until, ultimately at the very end, they all return to the Lord.

And this is the aspect of “Happy are those who dwell in Your house,” which is placed adjacent to the verse “Happy is the man whose strength is in You.” For the essence of strength and of strengthening oneself to hold oneself to the Lord, blessed be He, wherever one may be, is through meriting to be among “those who dwell in Your house,” who are the aspect of the upper house and the lower house, in whose building the righteous man is engaged, as mentioned above. For through this comes the essential strengthening, concerning which it is said, “Happy is the man whose strength is in You”—happy indeed, for this is the essential thing, as is known. And through this comes the essential drawing forth of the Torah, which the righteous man draws forth to Israel in every generation, the essential thing being through the aspect of these collections. And as understood in the Torah teaching “Happy is the people”—Providence (section 13, Likutay, Part 1)—the aspect of “And he who takes souls is wise,” etc.; the aspect of “I gathered my myrrh with my spice,” etc. For through this, “A wise man ascended the city of mighty men, and brought down the strength of its confidence.”

(Halachos of Gifts, Halacha 4, item 63)

pairs.he: אֲבָל הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת הוּא בְּחִינַת יָשִׂישׂ כְּגִבּוֹר לָרוּץ אֹרַח וְכוּ׳ כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר שָׁם, וְכָל הִתְגַּבְּרוּתוֹ הִיא רַק עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת וְהוּא כְּחָתָן יוֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ, שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל יוֹצֵא מֵחָכְמוֹת חִיצוֹנִיּוֹת וּמִמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת רָעוֹת וְהִרְהוּרִים רָעִים וְכוּ׳ כַּמּוּבָן שָׁם בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַנִּזְכֶּרֶת לְעֵיל. אֲבָל הוּא סוֹבֵל מַרְעִין וְיִסּוּרִים רַבִּים מֵאִתָּנוּ בִּבְחִינַת וְהוּא מְחֹלָל מִפְּשָׁעֵינוּ וְכוּ׳, מֵחֲמַת שֶׁבְּכָל פַּעַם שֶׁאֶחָד מִתְעוֹרֵר מְעַט לָשׁוּב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ תֵּכֶף מִתְגַּבְּרִין עָלָיו וְכוּ׳, וְהוּא אֵינוֹ מִתְגַּבֵּר כָּרָאוּי וְכוּ׳, כַּיָּדוּעַ כָּל זֶה מַה שֶׁעוֹבֵר עַל כָּל אֶחָד.
pairs.en: But the true righteous man is the aspect of “He rejoices like a mighty man to run a course,” etc., as explained there; and all his prevailing is only through the aspect of “And he is like a bridegroom coming out of his canopy”—which is through each one of Israel coming out of external wisdoms and out of evil thoughts and evil contemplations, etc., as understood there in the aforementioned Torah teaching. But he suffers ailments and many afflictions from us, in the aspect of “And he is wounded because of our transgressions,” etc., because each time someone awakens a little to return to the Lord, blessed be He, immediately they prevail against him, etc., and he does not prevail as he ought, etc.; as is known, all this is what passes over each one.

pairs.he: אֲבָל הָעִקַּר הוּא הַהִתְחַזְּקוּת בְּכֹחַ הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לֵידַע שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק הוּא גִּבּוֹר כֹּחַ כָּזֶה שֶׁכָּל נְקֻדָּה וּנְקֻדָּה טוֹבָה שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר כָּל אֶחָד בְּאֵיזֶה רֶגַע, הוּא חוֹטֵף אוֹתָהּ מִיָּד וּמַכְנִיסָהּ לְתוֹךְ בֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהוּא בּוֹנֶה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מִשְׁכָּן וּבֵית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת בֵּיתָא תַּתָּאָה וְכוּ׳ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. וְעַל כֵּן אֲפִלּוּ כְּשֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ יוֹרֵד כְּמוֹ שֶׁיּוֹרֵד זֶה שֶׁרָצָה לְהִתְקָרֵב, אַף עַל פִּי כֵן אֵינוֹ נֶאֱבָד הַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת הַמְּעַט שֶׁלּוֹ, כִּי כְּבָר נִכְנַס לְתוֹךְ בִּנְיַן בֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק בְּבִנְיָנוֹ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל.
pairs.en: But the essential thing is strengthening oneself through the power of the righteous man: one must know that the righteous man is so mighty in power that every single good point in which each one prevails at some moment—he snatches it at once and brings it into the house of holiness that he is building, which is the aspect of the Tabernacle and the Temple, which is the aspect of the lower house, etc., as mentioned above. And therefore, even when afterward the one who wished to draw near descends as he descends, nevertheless his little awakening is not lost, because it has already entered into the building of the house of holiness whose building the righteous man is engaged in, as mentioned above.

pairs.he: כל אחד צריך להתחזק לא להניח מקומו
pairs.en: Each one must strengthen himself not to abandon his place.

qualifiedAfter.he: כל אחד צריך להתחזק לא להניח מקומו
qualifiedAfter.en: Each one must strengthen himself not to abandon his place.

pairs.he: עַל כֵּן צָרִיךְ כָּל אֶחָד לִבְלִי לְהַנִּיחַ אֶת מְקוֹמוֹ בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן בִּבְחִינַת מְקוֹמְךָ אַל תַּנַּח, וּבְכָל פַּעַם שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר עַל מַחֲשַׁבְתּוֹ הָרָעָה וּמְנַשֵּׂא עַצְמוֹ לַחֲשֹׁב מַחֲשָׁבוֹת טוֹבוֹת וּמִתְגַּעְגֵּעַ וְכוֹסֵף לְהִתְקָרֵב לַה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ לֵית רְעוּתָא טָבָא דְּאִתְאַבַּד, מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מַה שֶׁעוֹשֶׂה בְּכָל פַּעַם אֵיזֶה דָּבָר שֶׁבִּקְדֻשָּׁה, כִּי הֲלֹא אֲפִלּוּ פּוֹשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מְלֵאִים מִצְווֹת כְּרִמּוֹן וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: Therefore each one must not abandon his place in any manner, in the aspect of “Do not leave your place”; and each time he prevails over his evil thought and lifts himself up to think good thoughts, and yearns and longs to draw near to the Lord, blessed be He—“No good will is lost.” All the more so, whatever holy thing he does each time; for indeed, even the sinners of Israel are full of commandments like a pomegranate, etc.

pairs.he: (וְכַמְּבֹאָר בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה מִזֶּה וּבִפְרָט עַל פָּסוּק אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹקַי בְּעוֹדִי וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהִזְהִיר הוּא זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה לֵילֵךְ עִם זֶה מְאֹד).
pairs.en: (And as explained extensively about this in our words, and particularly concerning the verse “I will sing to my God while I yet am,” etc., which he, of blessed memory, warned one to walk with very much).

qualifiedAfter.he: (וְכַמְּבֹאָר בִּדְבָרֵינוּ הַרְבֵּה מִזֶּה וּבִפְרָט עַל פָּסוּק אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹקַי בְּעוֹדִי וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהִזְהִיר הוּא זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה לֵילֵךְ עִם זֶה מְאֹד).
qualifiedAfter.en: (And as explained extensively about this in our words, and particularly concerning the verse “I will sing to my God while I yet am,” etc., which he, of blessed memory, warned one to walk with very much).

pairs.he: וְהָעִקַּר הוּא כֹּחַ הַצַּדִּיק שֶׁעוֹסֵק בְּתִקּוּן הָעוֹלָמוֹת עַל יְדֵי תִּקּוּן נַפְשׁוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמְּקַבֵּץ וּמְלַקֵּט בְּכָל עֵת וָרֶגַע כָּל מַחֲשָׁבָה וּמַחֲשָׁבָה טוֹבָה וְכָל דִּבּוּר וּמַעֲשֶׂה טוֹב וּמַכְנִיס אוֹתָם תֵּכֶף לְתוֹךְ בֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה וְכוּ׳ כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל, עַד שֶׁמִּתְקַבְּצִים וּמִתְלַקְּטִים כָּל הַנְּקֻדּוֹת טוֹבוֹת שֶׁל כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד, עַד שֶׁיֵּשׁ לְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד חֵלֶק גָּדוֹל בְּבִנְיַן הַבֵּית הַקְּדֻשָּׁה, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה מִתְבָּרְרִים הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת וְנַעֲשִׂים כֵּלִים לְקַבֵּל הָאוֹר אֵין סוֹף שֶׁמֵּאִיר בְּלֵב כָּל אֶחָד בְּכָל יוֹם עַד שֶׁסּוֹף כָּל סוֹף יָשׁוּבוּ הַכֹּל אֶל ה׳.
pairs.en: And the essential thing is the power of the righteous man, who is engaged in the repair of the worlds through the repair of the souls of Israel; this is through his gathering and collecting, at every time and moment, every single good thought and every good utterance and deed, and bringing them immediately into the house of holiness, etc., as mentioned above, until all the good points of each and every one are gathered and collected, until each and every one has a large share in the building of the house of holiness, through which the sparks are refined and vessels are made to receive the light of the Infinite, which shines in the heart of each one every day, until, ultimately at the very end, they all return to the Lord.

pairs.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ שֶׁנִּסְמַךְ לְפָסוּק אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עֹז לוֹ בָךְ. כִּי עִקַּר הָעֹז וְהַהִתְחַזְּקוּת לֶאֱחֹז עַצְמוֹ בַּה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא, הוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁזּוֹכֶה לִהְיוֹת בִּכְלַל יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת בֵּיתָא עִלָּאָה וּבֵיתָא תַּתָּאָה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק עוֹסֵק בְּבִנְיָנָם כַּנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה עִקַּר הַהִתְחַזְּקוּת, שֶׁעַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עֹז לוֹ בָךְ, אַשְׁרֵי בְּוַדַּאי כִּי זֶה הָעִקַּר כַּיָּדוּעַ. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה עִקַּר הַמְשָׁכַת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק מַמְשִׁיךְ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל דּוֹר שֶׁהָעִקַּר עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת לִקּוּטִים אֵלּוּ. וְכַמּוּבָן בְּתוֹרָה אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם הַשְׁגָּחָה (סימן יג לקוטי חלק א) בְּחִינַת וְלֹקֵחַ נְפָשׁוֹת חָכָם וְכוּ׳. בְּחִינַת אָרִיתִי מוֹרִי עִם בְּשָׂמִי וְכוּ׳. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה עִיר גִּבֹּרִים עָלָה חָכָם וַיֵּרֶד עֹז מִבְטֶחָה.
pairs.en: And this is the aspect of “Happy are those who dwell in Your house,” which is placed adjacent to the verse “Happy is the man whose strength is in You.” For the essence of strength and of strengthening oneself to hold oneself to the Lord, blessed be He, wherever one may be, is through meriting to be among “those who dwell in Your house,” who are the aspect of the upper house and the lower house, in whose building the righteous man is engaged, as mentioned above. For through this comes the essential strengthening, concerning which it is said, “Happy is the man whose strength is in You”—happy indeed, for this is the essential thing, as is known. And through this comes the essential drawing forth of the Torah, which the righteous man draws forth to Israel in every generation, the essential thing being through the aspect of these collections. And as understood in the Torah teaching “Happy is the people”—Providence (section 13, Likutay, Part 1)—the aspect of “And he who takes souls is wise,” etc.; the aspect of “I gathered my myrrh with my spice,” etc. For through this, “A wise man ascended the city of mighty men, and brought down the strength of its confidence.”

קמה.

כמ״ש האריז״ל בעץ חיים (שער ל״ט פרק א׳): כי אז כתיב בלע המות לנצח שהם הקליפות אשר חיותם הוא בחי׳ המ״ן אלו שלא הובררו והם עדיין בתוכם ואם היו נבררין לגמרי היה מסתלק מהם כל החיות והיו מתים לגמרי וזהו ענין אין בן דוד בא עד שיכלו כל הנשמות שבגוף כי כאשר יכלה כל הנשמות הקדושות לצאת משם ועולין בבחי׳ מ״ן שמהם נוצרים הנשמות כנ״ל בתחלת הדרוש לא יהיה עוד חיות אל הקליפות וימותו ויתבטלו וזהו בלע המות לנצח כי הקליפות נקרא מות תתבלע ותתבטל לגמרי. וז״ש פרשת פקודי דף רנ״ח ע״ב, כד יסתיים גלותא במשיכו דרגלין ברגלין כדין יבא משיח כי הרי אלו בחי׳ המלכים הם אדם א׳ מראשו ועד רגליו אשר נטבע באלו הקלי׳ ובכל פעם ופעם שיש זווג עליון אנו מעלין ע״י תפלתינו ניצוצות הקדושה שבו בבחי׳ מ״ן וכאשר יתבררו ויעלו גם הניצוצין אשר ברגליו אז יושלם להתתקן כל אדם הזה אז יבא משיח וענין רגליו אלו הוא בעשיה שהוא בחי׳ רגלים ושם הוא סיום הקדושה שהוא המלכות הנקרא קץ הימין וכנגדו בקליפה אשר שם נקרא קץ הימים וכאשר יתוקנו הנשמות אשר נפלו עד שם אז יהיה זמן הגאולה. ע״כ. ושם בשער מ״א פרק ב׳. וכן בשער המצוות פרשת ראה ועוד מקומות.
segments.en:
145.

As the Arizal wrote in Aitz Chayim (gate 39, chapter 1): For then it is written, “He swallowed up death forever,” which refers to the shells whose vitality is the aspect of these M״N that were not clarified and are still within them. If they were completely clarified, all vitality would depart from them and they would die entirely. This is the meaning of “The son of David does not come until all the souls in the body are exhausted”: when all the holy souls finish departing from there and ascend in the aspect of M״N, from which the souls are formed, as stated above at the beginning of the exposition, the shells will no longer have vitality and will die and be nullified. This is “He swallowed up death forever,” for the shells are called death: it will be swallowed and nullified entirely. This is what is stated in the portion Pikooday, folio 258b: “When the exile is completed in the drawing of legs in legs, then Messiah will come.” For these kings are the aspect of one person, from his head to his legs, who was submerged within these shells. And each and every time there is a supernal union, through our prayers we raise the sparks of holiness within him in the aspect of M״N. כמ״ש האריז״ל בעץ חיים (שער ל״ט פרק א׳): כי אז כתיב בלע המות לנצח שהם הקליפות אשר חיותם הוא בחי׳ המ״ן אלו שלא הובררו והם עדיין בתוכם ואם היו נבררין לגמרי היה מסתלק מהם כל החיות והיו מתים לגמרי וזהו ענין אין בן דוד בא עד שיכלו כל הנשמות שבגוף כי כאשר יכלה כל הנשמות הקדושות לצאת משם ועולין בבחי׳ מ״ן שמהם נוצרים הנשמות כנ״ל בתחלת הדרוש לא יהיה עוד חיות אל הקליפות וימותו ויתבטלו וזהו בלע המות לנצח כי הקליפות נקרא מות תתבלע ותתבטל לגמרי. וז״ש פרשת פקודי דף רנ״ח ע״ב, כד יסתיים גלותא במשיכו דרגלין ברגלין כדין יבא משיח כי הרי אלו בחי׳ המלכים הם אדם א׳ מראשו ועד רגליו אשר נטבע באלו הקלי׳ ובכל פעם ופעם שיש זווג עליון אנו מעלין ע״י תפלתינו ניצוצות הקדושה שבו בבחי׳ מ״ן וכאשר יתבררו ויעלו גם הניצוצין אשר ברגליו אז יושלם להתתקן כל אדם הזה אז יבא משיח וענין רגליו אלו הוא בעשיה שהוא בחי׳ רגלים ושם הוא סיום הקדושה שהוא המלכות הנקרא קץ הימין וכנגדו בקליפה אשר שם נקרא קץ הימים וכאשר יתוקנו הנשמות אשר נפלו עד שם אז יהיה זמן הגאולה. ע״כ. ושם בשער מ״א פרק ב׳. וכן בשער המצוות פרשת ראה ועוד מקומות.

If they were completely clarified, all vitality would depart from them and they would die entirely. This is the meaning of “The son of David does not come until all the souls in the body are exhausted”: when all the holy souls finish departing from there and ascend in the aspect of M״N, from which the souls are formed, as stated above at the beginning of the exposition, the shells will no longer have vitality and will die and be nullified. segments.he:
״וַיְלַקֵּט יוֹסֵף אֶת כָּל הַכֶּסֶף״ וגו׳

(מ״ז, יד)

זֶה בְּחִינַת וַיְלַקֵּט יוֹסֵף אֶת כָּל הַכֶּסֶף וְכוּ׳. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת בִּזַּת מִצְרַיִם וּבִזַּת הַיָּם, בְּחִינַת וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יֵצְאוּ בִּרְכֻשׁ גָּדוֹל, שֶׁלֹּא רָצָה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְהוֹצִיאָם מִמִּצְרַיִם עַד שֶׁיִּשְׁאֲלוּ אִישׁ מֵאֵת רֵעֵהוּ וְכוּ׳ כְּלֵי כֶּסֶף וְכוּ׳ הַכֹּל בִּשְׁבִיל בֵּרוּר הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת הַקְּדוֹשִׁים קמו.

שֶׁמְּבָרְרִים אוֹתָם בְּיוֹתֵר עַל יְדֵי מָמוֹן וַעֲשִׁירוּת דִּקְדֻשָּׁה. כְּשֶׁמַּעֲלִין אֶת הַמָּמוֹן וְהָעֲשִׁירוּת מֵהַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא אֶל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה, כִּי בְּהַמָּמוֹן כְּלוּלִין כָּל הַכֹּחוֹת שֶׁל כָּל הַדְּבָרִים כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי מִצְרַיִם מְלֵאָה גִּלּוּלִים וַעֲבוֹדָה זָרָה וְלֹא הָיוּ מַאֲמִינִים בְּהַשְׁגָּחַת ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ רַק אָמַר, לִי יְאוֹרִי וַאֲנִי עֲשִׂיתִנִי, כִּי שָׁם לֹא הָיָה יוֹרֵד הַמָּטָר וּמֵחֲמַת זֶה הִתְגַּבְּרוּ הַכְּפִירוֹת שָׁם בְּיוֹתֵר וְעַל כֵּן שָׁם קָשֶׁה לְהַעֲלוֹת הַכֹּחוֹת וְהַחִיּוּת שֶׁל כָּל הַתְּבוּאָה וְהַצְּמָחִים לְתוֹךְ הַתְּפִלָּה מֵחֲמַת שֶׁאֵין הַמָּטָר יוֹרֵד שָׁם, כַּמּוּבָן בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַנַּ״ל שֶׁעִקַּר בְּחִינָה זֹאת לְהַעֲלוֹת כָּל כֹּחוֹת שִׂיחַ הַשָּׂדֶה לְתוֹךְ הַתְּפִלָּה הוּא מֵחֲמַת שֶׁגְּדֵלִים עַל יְדֵי הַמָּטָר וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם. וְעַל כֵּן בֶּאֱמֶת בְּמִצְרַיִם אֵין שָׁם מְקוֹם תְּפִלָּה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בְּרבנו זכרונו לברכה (בסימן ז). כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, כְּצֵאתִי אֶת הָעִיר אֶפְרֹשׂ אֶת כַּפַּי וְכוּ׳.

וְעַל כֵּן סִבֵּב ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָיו הַנּוֹרָאוֹת שֶׁכָּל הָאָרֶץ יָבֹאוּ מִצְרַיְמָה אֶל יוֹסֵף לִשְׁבֹּר תְּבוּאָה מִמִּצְרַיִם וְשֶׁיֶּאֱסֹף יוֹסֵף עַל יְדֵי זֶה כָּל הַכֶּסֶף וְכוּ׳. וְאַחַר כָּךְ הֶעֱלוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל הַכֶּסֶף הַזֶּה לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הֶעֱלוּ כָּל כֹּחוֹת הַתְּבוּאָה וְהַצְּמָחִים לִירוּשָׁלַיִם שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה. וּבָזֶה תִּקְּנוּ כָּל הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁהָיוּ בָּהֶם כִּי הַכֹּל נִתְתַּקֵּן עַל יְדֵי זֶה.

(הלכות ערלה הלכה ד׳ אות כ״ה)
segments.en:
“And Yosef gathered all the silver,” etc.

(47:14)

This is the aspect of “And Yosef gathered all the silver,” etc. And this is the aspect of the spoils of Egypt and the spoils of the sea, the aspect of “And afterwards they shall depart with great property,” for the Holy One, blessed be He, did not wish to bring them out of Egypt until each man would ask of his fellow, etc., vessels of silver, etc.—all for the clarification of the holy sparks [printed apparatus marker 146].

They are clarified especially through money and wealth of holiness, when money and wealth are raised from the other side to holiness. For within money are included all the powers of all things, as stated above. For Egypt is full of idols and idolatry, and they did not believe in the providence of the blessed Lord; rather, he said, “My river is mine, and I made myself.” For rain did not fall there, and because of this denial grew especially powerful there. Therefore there it is difficult to raise the powers and vitality of all the produce and plants into prayer, because rain does not fall there, as is understood in the aforementioned discourse: the principal aspect of raising all the powers of the shrubs of the field into prayer is because they grow through rain, etc.; see there. Therefore, in truth, in Egypt there is no place for prayer, as explained by our master of blessed memory (in discourse 7), as it is written, “When I go out of the city, I shall spread my palms,” etc.

And therefore the blessed Lord arranged, through His awe-inspiring wonders, that all the earth would come to Egypt, to Yosef, to buy produce from Egypt, and that Yosef would thereby gather all the silver, etc. And afterwards Israel raised all this silver to the land of Israel, and through this they raised all the powers of the produce and the plants to Jerusalem, which is the aspect of prayer. Through this they rectified all the holy sparks that were within them, for everything is rectified through this.

(Laws of Orluh, law 4, item 25)

For Egypt is full of idols and idolatry, and they did not believe in the providence of the blessed Lord; rather, he said, “My river is mine, and I made myself.” For rain did not fall there, and because of this denial grew especially powerful there. Therefore there it is difficult to raise the powers and vitality of all the produce and plants into prayer, because rain does not fall there, as is understood in the aforementioned discourse: the principal aspect of raising all the powers of the shrubs of the field into prayer is because they grow through rain, etc.; see there. Therefore, in truth, in Egypt there is no place for prayer, as explained by our master of blessed memory (in discourse 7), as it is written, “When I go out of the city, I shall spread my palms,” etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: They are clarified especially through money and wealth of holiness, when money and wealth are raised from the other side to holiness. pairs.he: וְעַל כֵּן סִבֵּב ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָיו הַנּוֹרָאוֹת שֶׁכָּל הָאָרֶץ יָבֹאוּ מִצְרַיְמָה אֶל יוֹסֵף לִשְׁבֹּר תְּבוּאָה מִמִּצְרַיִם וְשֶׁיֶּאֱסֹף יוֹסֵף עַל יְדֵי זֶה כָּל הַכֶּסֶף וְכוּ׳. וְאַחַר כָּךְ הֶעֱלוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּל הַכֶּסֶף הַזֶּה לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הֶעֱלוּ כָּל כֹּחוֹת הַתְּבוּאָה וְהַצְּמָחִים לִירוּשָׁלַיִם שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה. וּבָזֶה תִּקְּנוּ כָּל הַנִּיצוֹצוֹת הַקְּדוֹשִׁים שֶׁהָיוּ בָּהֶם כִּי הַכֹּל נִתְתַּקֵּן עַל יְדֵי זֶה.
pairs.en: And therefore the blessed Lord arranged, through His awe-inspiring wonders, that all the earth would come to Egypt, to Yosef, to buy produce from Egypt, and that Yosef would thereby gather all the silver, etc. And afterwards Israel raised all this silver to the land of Israel, and through this they raised all the powers of the produce and the plants to Jerusalem, which is the aspect of prayer. Through this they rectified all the holy sparks that were within them, for everything is rectified through this.

segments.he:
קמו.

המגיד מקאזניץ ז״ל בעבודת ישראל (פרשת מקץ) כתב: הכתוב אומר ויצבר יוסף ב״ר, הם ר״ב ניצוצין. הרבה מא״ד, אותיות אד״ם שם מ״ה שעל ידי זה השם הוא התיקון למלכין דמיתו להעלות הניצוצין קדישין. עד כי חדל לספור כי אין מספר, ר״ל שאח״כ העלה אותם לבחינת אי״ן הם העולמות הרמים והנשאים שרשי הניצ״ק והרימם ונשאם ונטלם לעולמות הגבוהים למעלה ממספר וחשבון, וזה וילקט יוסף את כל הכסף, כי חלילה לזרע יעקב אבינו ע״ה ולצדיק יסוד עולם שיהיה מגמתו לאסוף ולצבור כסף וזהב כדרך המוני עם, רק היתה כונתו לשם שמים ללקט הניצוצות קדישין ואהבתם וחמדתם הנקרא בלשון כסף כי נכסוף נכספתה, ויבא אתם ביתה פרעה תחת ידו, וממילא אח״כ יקל לבני ישראל להוציא הניצ״ק המכונסין ואסופים ולעשות מצרים ככתוב וינצלו את מצרים. ע״כ.
segments.en:
146.

The Maggid of Kozhnitz, of blessed memory, wrote in Avodas Yisrael (the portion Mikaitz): Scripture says, “And Yosef accumulated B״R”; these are R״B sparks. “Much”—M A״D, the letters A״D״M, the name M״H, through which name comes the rectification of the kings who died, to raise the holy sparks. “Until he ceased counting, for there was no number”: that is to say, afterwards he raised them to the aspect of Ayin, which is the high and exalted worlds, the roots of the Nitz״K, and lifted them and bore them and took them to the higher worlds, beyond number and calculation. And this is “And Yosef gathered all the silver”; for far be it from the seed of Yaakov our father, peace upon him, and from the righteous one, the foundation of the world, that his aim should be to gather and amass silver and gold in the manner of the masses. Rather, his intention was for the sake of Heaven, to gather the holy sparks and their love and desire, which is called in the language “silver,” for “you greatly longed.” “And he brought them into Pharaoh’s house,” under his hand; consequently, afterwards it would be easy for the children of Israel to bring out the Nitz״K that were assembled and gathered, and to make Egypt as it is written, “And they emptied Egypt.” End of quotation.

pairs.en: “And Judah approached him,” etc.

pairs.he: (מ״ד, יח)

צְרִיכִין לְהִתְפַּלֵּל הַרְבֵּה לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לְעֵצוֹת אֲמִתִּיּוֹת כָּאֵלֶּה, וְזֶהוּ וַיִּגַּשׁ אֵלָיו יְהוּדָה הֵם בְּחִינַת כְּלַל יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁנִּקְרָאִים הַיְּהוּדִים עַל שֵׁם יְהוּדָה, שֶׁהֵם נִגָּשִׁים אֶל יוֹסֵף בְּחִינַת הַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת וְשָׁבִים בִּתְשׁוּבָה עַל מְכִירָתוֹ, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים, בְּחִינַת חֲלֻקַּת הָעֵצָה.
pairs.en: One must pray much to the blessed God that one may merit such true counsels. This is “And Judah approached him”: they are the aspect of the entirety of Israel, who are called Jews after Judah. They approach Joseph, the aspect of the true righteous man, and repent for selling him, which is the aspect of impairing faith in the sages, the aspect of division in counsel.

qualifiedAfter.en: One must pray much to the blessed God that one may merit such true counsels. This is “And Judah approached him”: they are the aspect of the entirety of Israel, who are called Jews after Judah. They approach Joseph, the aspect of the true righteous man, and repent for selling him, which is the aspect of impairing faith in the sages, the aspect of division in counsel.

pairs.he: כִּי מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף הוּא בְּחִינַת חֲלֻקַּת מַלְכוּת בֵּית דָּוִד, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת חֲלֻקַּת הָעֵצָה, כַּמּוּבָן בְּהַהַפְטָרָה שֶׁל וַיִּגַּשׁ שֶׁמְּדַבֶּרֶת מִזֶּה כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב "וְלֹא יֵחָצוּ לִשְׁתֵּי מַמְלָכוֹת עוֹד". (ועין במקום אחר מזה).
pairs.en: For the selling of Joseph is the aspect of the division of the kingship of the House of David, which is the aspect of division in counsel, as is understood from the prophetic reading for Vayigash, which speaks of this, as it is written, “And they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.” (And see elsewhere concerning this.)

qualifiedAfter.en: For the selling of Joseph is the aspect of the division of the kingship of the House of David, which is the aspect of division in counsel, as is understood from the prophetic reading for Vayigash, which speaks of this, as it is written, “And they shall no longer be divided into two kingdoms.” (And see elsewhere concerning this.)

pairs.he: כִּי פָּרָשַׁת וַיִּגַּשׁ מְדַבֶּרֶת מִתִּקּוּן מְכִירַת יוֹסֵף שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת פְּגַם הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁשָּׁבִים בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּמְפַיְּסִים אוֹתוֹ וּמְבַקְּשִׁים מִמֶּנּוּ שֶׁיִּמְחֹל לָהֶם וְיַחֲזֹר וִיתַקְּנֵם בְּעֵצָה שְׁלֵמָה וְטוֹבָה בֶּאֱמֶת.
pairs.en: For the section of Vayigash speaks of rectifying the selling of Joseph, which is the aspect of impairing counsel, as stated above: they repent, appease him, and request of him that he forgive them and again rectify them through counsel that is complete and truly good.

qualifiedAfter.en: For the section of Vayigash speaks of rectifying the selling of Joseph, which is the aspect of impairing counsel, as stated above: they repent, appease him, and request of him that he forgive them and again rectify them through counsel that is complete and truly good.

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ "וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בִּי אֲדֹנִי יְדַבֶּר נָא עַבְדְּךָ דָבָר בְּאָזְנֵי אֲדֹנִי". וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י, יִכָּנְסוּ דְּבָרַי בְּאָזְנֶיךָ. שֶׁמְּבַקְּשִׁים אוֹתוֹ שֶׁיִּשְׁמַע הֵיטֵב וְיִכָּנְסוּ דְּבָרֵינוּ בְּאָזְנוֹ וּבְלִבּוֹ הֵיטֵב. כִּי שְׁמִיעָה בְּלִבָּא תַּלְיָא, הַיְנוּ שֶׁיְּרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְיָשִׂים לִבּוֹ הֵיטֵב הֵיטֵב מַה נַּעֲשֶׂה עִמָּנוּ בָּזֶה הָעוֹלָם וְיִתֵּן לָנוּ עֵצָה כָּרָאוּי לְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁנּוּכַל לְהַצִּיל עַצְמֵנוּ כָּל אֶחָד מִמַּה שֶּׁצָּרִיךְ, לְהִנָּצֵל שֶׁלֹּא תֹּאבַד תִּקְוָתֵנוּ חָלִילָה.
pairs.en: This is “And he said to him: Please, my lord, let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears.” Rashi explained: Let my words enter your ears. They request of him that he listen well and that our words enter his ear and his heart well. For hearing depends upon the heart. That is, that he have compassion upon us and give his attention very, very carefully to what is happening with us in this world, and give us counsel appropriate to each and every one, in such a way that we can save ourselves, each one from that from which he needs to be saved, so that our hope will not be lost, Heaven forbid.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is “And he said to him: Please, my lord, let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears.” Rashi explained: Let my words enter your ears. They request of him that he listen well and that our words enter his ear and his heart well. For hearing depends upon the heart. That is, that he have compassion upon us and give his attention very, very carefully to what is happening with us in this world, and give us counsel appropriate to each and every one, in such a way that we can save ourselves, each one from that from which he needs to be saved, so that our hope will not be lost, Heaven forbid.

pairs.he: כִּי זֶה כְּלָל, שֶׁבַּדֶּרֶךְ שֶׁאָדָם רוֹצֶה לֵילֵךְ מוֹלִיכִין אוֹתוֹ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁשּׁוֹאֲלִים אֶת הַצַּדִּיק כֵּן הוּא מֵשִׁיב. וּמִזֶּה בָּאִים כָּל הָעֵצוֹת הַמְקֻלְקָלוֹת שֶׁנִּדְמֶה לוֹ שֶׁמֵּאֵת ה׳ הֵם אוֹ שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק יָעַץ לוֹ כֵּן, וּבֶאֱמֶת הַכֹּל מִמֶּנּוּ בְּעַצְמוֹ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב "אִוֶּלֶת אָדָם תְּסַלֵּף דַּרְכּוֹ" וְכוּ׳ שֶׁדָּרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה מִקְרָא זֶה עַל הַשְּׁבָטִים שֶׁפָּגְמוּ בְּעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: For this is a rule: along the way that a person wishes to go, they lead him. And according to the way in which one questions the righteous man, so he replies. From this come all the corrupt counsels that seem to him to be from the Lord, or that the righteous man counseled him thus; in truth, everything comes from himself, as it is written, “A person’s folly perverts his way,” etc. Our rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded this verse concerning the tribes, who impaired counsel as stated above.

qualifiedAfter.en: For this is a rule: along the way that a person wishes to go, they lead him. And according to the way in which one questions the righteous man, so he replies. From this come all the corrupt counsels that seem to him to be from the Lord, or that the righteous man counseled him thus; in truth, everything comes from himself, as it is written, “A person’s folly perverts his way,” etc. Our rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded this verse concerning the tribes, who impaired counsel as stated above.

pairs.he: עַל כֵּן מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לָחוּס עַל עַצְמוֹ בֶּאֱמֶת צָרִיךְ לְבַקֵּשׁ מְאֹד בְּתַחֲנוּנִים רַבִּים אֶת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְאֶת הַצַּדִּיק אֱמֶת שֶׁיָּשִׂימוּ לִבָּם הֵיטֵב עַל מַה שֶּׁנַּעֲשֶׂה עִמּוֹ, בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיִּתְּנוּ לוֹ עֵצָה אֲמִתִּית וְנִצְחִית שֶׁיַּצְלִיחַ עַל יָדָהּ לָנֶצַח בֶּאֱמֶת.
pairs.en: Therefore, anyone who truly wishes to have compassion upon himself must entreat the blessed God and the true righteous man very much, with many supplications, that they attend carefully to what is happening with him, in such a way that they give him true and eternal counsel, through which he will truly prosper forever.

qualifiedAfter.en: Therefore, anyone who truly wishes to have compassion upon himself must entreat the blessed God and the true righteous man very much, with many supplications, that they attend carefully to what is happening with him, in such a way that they give him true and eternal counsel, through which he will truly prosper forever.

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ "וְאַל יִחַר אַפְּךָ בְּעַבְדֶּךָ" הַיְנוּ שֶׁיִּתְבַּטֵּל כָּל מִינֵי חֲרוֹן אַף וְדִינִים כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַתְּשׁוּבָה עַל פְּגַם אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים נִתְבַּטְּלִים כָּל מִינֵי דִּינִים שֶׁהֵם חֲרוֹן אַף, כִּי נִכְלָלִין בִּבְחִינַת קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים שֶׁמִּשָּׁם כָּל הַהַמְתָּקוֹת שֶׁבָּעוֹלָם, וְכָל מַה שֶּׁנִּמְתָּק הַדִּין בְּיוֹתֵר נִשְׁלְמָה הָעֵצָה בְּיוֹתֵר עַד שֶׁזּוֹכֶה בְּכָל פַּעַם לְעֵצָה שְׁלֵמָה הַנִּמְשֶׁכֶת מֵהַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת, שֶׁיּוּכַל לַעֲמֹד עַל יָדָהּ כְּנֶגֶד כָּל מִינֵי עֵצוֹת מְקֻלְקָלוֹת שֶׁהַבַּעַל דָּבָר מְסַבֵּב בְּלִבּוֹ בְּכָל יוֹם וּבְכָל עֵת.
pairs.en: This is “And let your anger not burn against your servant”: that is, that all kinds of burning anger and judgments be annulled, as stated above. Through repentance for impairing faith in the sages, all kinds of judgments—which are burning anger—are annulled, for they are included in the aspect of the Holy of Holies, from which come all the sweetenings in the world. The more the judgment is sweetened, the more counsel is made complete, until one merits, each time, complete counsel drawn from the true righteous man, through which one can stand against all kinds of corrupt counsels that the adversary brings about in one’s heart every day and at every time.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is “And let your anger not burn against your servant”: that is, that all kinds of burning anger and judgments be annulled, as stated above. Through repentance for impairing faith in the sages, all kinds of judgments—which are burning anger—are annulled, for they are included in the aspect of the Holy of Holies, from which come all the sweetenings in the world. The more the judgment is sweetened, the more counsel is made complete, until one merits, each time, complete counsel drawn from the true righteous man, through which one can stand against all kinds of corrupt counsels that the adversary brings about in one’s heart every day and at every time.

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ "כִּי כָמוֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹה" פַּרְעֹה זֶה בְּחִינַת בִּטּוּל וְקִלְקוּל הָעֵצָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה, בִּבְחִינַת "וַתִּפְרְעוּ כָּל עֲצָתִי", שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה כָּל גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם שֶׁכּוֹלֵל כָּל הַגָּלֻיּוֹת, כִּי פַּרְעֹה עוֹמֵד אֵצֶל הָעֹרֶף וְרוֹצֶה לְעַכֵּב הַמֹּחִין שֶׁלֹּא יֵרְדוּ לְמַטָּה שֶׁיִּתְהַוּוּ מֵהֶם עֵצוֹת טוֹבוֹת לְהַכִּיר הַבּוֹרֵא יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יָדָם, שֶׁזֶּהוּ עִקַּר סוֹד גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם (ועין בכונות ובזהר היטב). וְעִקַּר הַתִּקּוּן עַל יְדֵי קַבָּלַת הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁזָּכִינוּ בְּעֵת יְצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם שֶׁהוּא תַּרְיַ״ג עֵטִין דְּאוֹרַיְתָא, בִּבְחִינַת לִי עֵצָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה, בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הָעֵצָה כַּנַּ״ל. וְהָעִקָּר הוּא לְקַבֵּל עֵצוֹת מֵהַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת בְּאֹפֶן שֶׁיּוּכַל לַעֲמֹד עַל יָדָם בְּכָל פַּעַם כְּנֶגֶד קִלְקוּל וּבִלְבּוּל הָעֵצוֹת שֶׁל הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת פַּרְעֹה כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: This is “For you are like Pharaoh.” Pharaoh is the aspect of annulling and corrupting holy counsel, in the aspect of “And you rejected all my counsel”; through this came the entire Egyptian exile, which comprises all the exiles. For Pharaoh stands at the nape and wishes to obstruct the intellects, so that they will not descend below and become good counsels through which to recognize the blessed Creator. This is the principal secret of the Egyptian exile. (And examine the intentions and the Zohar carefully.) The principal rectification is through receiving the Torah, which we merited at the time of the Exodus from Egypt: it is the 613 counsels of the Torah, in the aspect of “Counsel and sound wisdom are mine,” the aspect of rectifying counsel, as stated above. The principal thing is to receive counsels from the true righteous man in such a way that one can stand through them, each time, against the corruption and confusion of counsels of the other side, which are the aspect of Pharaoh, as stated above.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is “For you are like Pharaoh.” Pharaoh is the aspect of annulling and corrupting holy counsel, in the aspect of “And you rejected all my counsel”; through this came the entire Egyptian exile, which comprises all the exiles. For Pharaoh stands at the nape and wishes to obstruct the intellects, so that they will not descend below and become good counsels through which to recognize the blessed Creator. This is the principal secret of the Egyptian exile. (And examine the intentions and the Zohar carefully.) The principal rectification is through receiving the Torah, which we merited at the time of the Exodus from Egypt: it is the 613 counsels of the Torah, in the aspect of “Counsel and sound wisdom are mine,” the aspect of rectifying counsel, as stated above. The principal thing is to receive counsels from the true righteous man in such a way that one can stand through them, each time, against the corruption and confusion of counsels of the other side, which are the aspect of Pharaoh, as stated above.

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ "כִּי כָמוֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹה" הַיְנוּ כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁפַּרְעֹה שֶׁהוּא קִלְקוּל הָעֵצָה, מִתְגַּבֵּר בְּנִכְלֵי וְעַרְמִימִיּוֹתָיו, כְּמוֹ כֵן אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ לִתֵּן עֵצוֹת בְּכָל פַּעַם לְהִנָּצֵל מֵעַרְמִימִיּוֹתָיו וְלָשׁוּב וּלְהִתְחַזֵּק לִשָּׁאֵר עַל עָמְדוֹ לְהִתְחַזֵּק עַצְמוֹ בְּהַתּוֹרָה הַקְּדוֹשָׁה שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר הָעֵצָה הַשְּׁלֵמָה.
pairs.en: This is “For you are like Pharaoh”: that is, in accordance with how Pharaoh—who is the corruption of counsel—gains strength through his schemes and cunning, so you know how to give counsels each time to escape his cunning, and to return and strengthen oneself to remain in one’s position, to strengthen oneself in the holy Torah, which is the essence of complete counsel.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is “For you are like Pharaoh”: that is, in accordance with how Pharaoh—who is the corruption of counsel—gains strength through his schemes and cunning, so you know how to give counsels each time to escape his cunning, and to return and strengthen oneself to remain in one’s position, to strengthen oneself in the holy Torah, which is the essence of complete counsel.

pairs.he: וְזֶהוּ "כִּי כָמוֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹה" כִּי שְׁנֵי הַכָּפִין מוֹרִין עַל הַדִּמְיוֹן מַמָּשׁ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י, הַיְנוּ כִּי זֶה עִקַּר נִפְלְאוֹת מַעֲשֵׂה הַצַּדִּיק כִּי נוֹרָא הוּא, כִּי יוֹדֵעַ וּמְחַזֵּק כָּל אָדָם כְּפִי מַה שֶּׁהוּא בְּכָל מַדְרֵגָה שֶׁהוּא בְּכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם בְּעֵצוֹת עֲמֻקּוֹת אֲמִתִּיּוֹת, שֶׁהֵם מְכֻוָּנִים מַמָּשׁ כְּפִי קִלְקוּל הָעֵצָה שֶׁרוֹצֶה הַבַּעַל דָּבָר לְהִתְגַּבֵּר עָלָיו בְּתַחְבּוּלוֹתָיו. עַל כֵּן הָעִקָּר הוּא תִּקּוּן אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים אֲמִתִּיִּים שֶׁעֲצָתָם בְּחִינַת מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים עֵצָה בְלֶב אִישׁ שֶׁאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְקַלְקֵל אוֹתָם בְּשׁוּם אֹפֶן בָּעוֹלָם.
pairs.en: This is “For you are like Pharaoh,” for the two letters kaf indicate an actual resemblance, as Rashi explained. That is, this is the principal wonder of the deed of the righteous man, for he is awesome: he knows and strengthens every person according to what he is, at whatever level he is, each and every day, with profound, true counsels. These are directed precisely in accordance with the corruption of counsel through which the adversary wishes to overpower him with his stratagems. Therefore the principal thing is rectifying faith in true sages, whose counsel is the aspect of “Deep waters are counsel in a man’s heart”; it is impossible to corrupt them in any manner whatsoever in the world.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is “For you are like Pharaoh,” for the two letters kaf indicate an actual resemblance, as Rashi explained. That is, this is the principal wonder of the deed of the righteous man, for he is awesome: he knows and strengthens every person according to what he is, at whatever level he is, each and every day, with profound, true counsels. These are directed precisely in accordance with the corruption of counsel through which the adversary wishes to overpower him with his stratagems. Therefore the principal thing is rectifying faith in true sages, whose counsel is the aspect of “Deep waters are counsel in a man’s heart”; it is impossible to corrupt them in any manner whatsoever in the world.

pairs.he: כִּי הֵם עוֹמְדִים כְּנֶגֶד כָּל מִינֵי קִלְקוּל הָעֵצָה שֶׁל הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא, בִּבְחִינַת כִּי כָמוֹךָ כְּפַרְעֹה כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵיהֶם, כִּי עֲצָתָם הוּא עֲצַת ה׳ אֲשֶׁר לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד כִּי אַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעוֹלָם ה׳.
pairs.en: For they stand against all kinds of corruption of counsel of the other side, in the aspect of “For you are like Pharaoh,” as stated above. For their thoughts are exceedingly deep, for their counsel is the counsel of the Lord, which will stand forever: “For You are exalted forever, Lord.”

qualifiedAfter.en: For they stand against all kinds of corruption of counsel of the other side, in the aspect of “For you are like Pharaoh,” as stated above. For their thoughts are exceedingly deep, for their counsel is the counsel of the Lord, which will stand forever: “For You are exalted forever, Lord.”

pairs.he: (מ״ה, ה)
עִקַּר יְצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם שֶׁהוּא פֶּסַח, הָיָה בִּזְכוּת יוֹסֵף, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב "וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת עַצְמוֹת יוֹסֵף עִמּוֹ". וְכַמּוּבָא.
pairs.en: The principal Exodus from Egypt, which is Passover, was through Joseph’s merit, as it is written, “And Moses took Joseph’s bones with him,” and as brought there.

qualifiedAfter.en: The principal Exodus from Egypt, which is Passover, was through Joseph’s merit, as it is written, “And Moses took Joseph’s bones with him,” and as brought there.

pairs.he: כִּי אִלְמָלֵא יָרַד יוֹסֵף לְמִצְרַיִם תְּחִלָּה, לֹא הָיָה אֶפְשָׁר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לָצֵאת מִשָּׁם, מִגֹּדֶל הַזֻּהֲמָא שֶׁהָיָה שָׁם, אַךְ עַל יְדֵי שֶׁיָּרַד יוֹסֵף תְּחִלָּה וְנִמְכַּר לְשָׁם לְעֶבֶד, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עַבְדוּת תֹּקֶף הָעֲשִׂיָּה, שֶׁשָּׁם אֲחִיזַת זֻהֲמַת הַנָּחָשׁ בְּחִינַת עַבְדוּת כַּנַּ״ל, וְעִקַּר בְּחִינַת הָעַבְדוּת הוּא בְּמִצְרַיִם שֶׁהָיָה מִזֶּרַע חָם שֶׁנִּתְקַלֵּל זַרְעוֹ לִהְיוֹת עֶבֶד עֲבָדִים וְנִתְהַפֵּךְ כָּל זַרְעוֹ זֻהֲמַת הַנָּחָשׁ בְּיוֹתֵר כַּיָּדוּעַ.
pairs.en: For had Joseph not descended to Egypt first, it would have been impossible for Israel to leave there because of the greatness of the impurity that was there. But through Joseph’s descending first and being sold there as a slave—which is the aspect of servitude, the intensity of the realm of action, where the serpent’s impurity has its hold, the aspect of servitude, as stated above; and the principal aspect of servitude is in Egypt, which was of the seed of Ham, whose seed was cursed to be a slave of slaves, and all his seed was transformed into the serpent’s impurity to an especially great degree, as is known.

qualifiedAfter.en: For had Joseph not descended to Egypt first, it would have been impossible for Israel to leave there because of the greatness of the impurity that was there. pairs.he: וְיוֹסֵף בְּגֹדֶל קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ הָעֲצוּמָה שֶׁיָּרַד לְתוֹךְ תֹּקֶף זֻהֲמַת מִצְרַיִם לְתוֹךְ בְּחִינַת עַבְדוּת כַּנַּ״ל וְהָיָה לוֹ נִסָּיוֹן גָּדוֹל שָׁם, וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן כָּבַשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ מֵאֵשֶׁת אֲדוֹנָיו, עַל יְדֵי זֶה שִׁבֵּר וְהִכְנִיעַ וּבִטֵּל אֶת הַזֻּהֲמָא שֶׁל מִצְרַיִם, וְרַק עַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה כֹּחַ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לִהְיוֹת בְּמִצְרַיִם וּלְבַלִּי לְהִשְׁתַּקֵּעַ שָׁם, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם. כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב "כִּי לְמִחְיָה שְׁלָחַנִי אֱלֹקִים לִפְנֵיכֶם וְכוּ׳". כִּי רַק עַל יָדוֹ זָכוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לָצֵאת מִשָּׁם לְהִנָּצֵל מִתֹּקֶף זֻהֲמָתָם קמא.
pairs.en: And Joseph, with the greatness of his immense holiness, who descended into the intensity of Egypt’s impurity, into the aspect of servitude, as stated above, and had a great trial there, nevertheless subdued his inclination with regard to his master’s wife. Through this he broke, subdued, and annulled the impurity of Egypt, and only through this did Israel have the strength to be in Egypt without becoming submerged there, Heaven forbid. As it is written, “For sustenance God sent me before you,” etc. For only through him did Israel merit to leave there, to be saved from the intensity of their impurity [printed note marker קמא].

pairs.en: It is the secret of carrying the Tabernacle.

pairs.en: “And he saw the wagons that Yosef had sent,” etc.

qualifiedAfter.en: “And he saw the wagons that Yosef had sent,” etc.

pairs.he: (מ״ה, כז)

זֶה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּיַעֲקֹב, וַיַּרְא אֶת הָעֲגָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח יוֹסֵף לָשֵׂאת אוֹתוֹ וַתְּחִי רוּחַ יַעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם. כִּי כְּשֶׁנָּשְׂאוּ אֶת יַעֲקֹב נָשְׂאוּ אוֹתוֹ בִּבְחִינַת הַמִּשְׁכָּן, כְּמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בְּפָרָשַׁת הַדְּגָלִים שֶׁהָיוּ מְסֻדָּרִים כְּמוֹ שֶׁצִּוָּה לָהֶם יַעֲקֹב לָשֵׂאת אוֹתוֹ אַחַר הִסְתַּלְּקוּתוֹ, כַּמּוּבָא בְּדִבְרֵי רבותינו זכרונם לברכה וּבְפֵרוּשׁ רש״י.
pairs.en: This is the aspect of what is stated concerning Yaakov: “And he saw the wagons that Yosef had sent to carry him, and the spirit of Yaakov their father revived.” For when they carried Yaakov, they carried him in the aspect of the Tabernacle, as is explained in the portion of the standards: they were arranged as Yaakov commanded them to carry him after his passing, as is brought in the words of our Rabbis of blessed memory and in Rashi’s explanation.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is the aspect of what is stated concerning Yaakov: “And he saw the wagons that Yosef had sent to carry him, and the spirit of Yaakov their father revived.” For when they carried Yaakov, they carried him in the aspect of the Tabernacle, as is explained in the portion of the standards: they were arranged as Yaakov commanded them to carry him after his passing, as is brought in the words of our Rabbis of blessed memory and in Rashi’s explanation.

pairs.he: וּבְוַדַּאי גַּם בְּחַיֵּי יַעֲקֹב הָיוּ כָּל נְסִיעוֹתָיו בִּבְחִינָה זֹאת בִּבְחִינַת נְסִיעַת הַשְּׁבָטִים עִם הַמִּשְׁכָּן, כִּי הָעִקָּר הוּא לִזְכּוֹת לָזֶה בְּחַיָּיו בִּבְחִינַת הַיּוֹם לַעֲשׂוֹתָם, וּמִי שֶׁטָּרַח בְּעֶרֶב שַׁבָּת וְכוּ׳. וְעַל כֵּן יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ קִדֵּשׁ אֶת עַצְמוֹ כָּל כָּךְ עַד שֶׁזָּכָה בְּחַיָּיו לָזֶה שֶׁכָּל נְסִיעוֹתָיו הָיוּ בַּבְּחִינָה הַנַּ״ל, בִּבְחִינַת נְסִיעַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עִם הַמִּשְׁכָּן.
pairs.en: And certainly, even during Yaakov’s life, all his journeys were in this aspect, in the aspect of the tribes journeying with the Tabernacle. For the main thing is to merit this during one’s lifetime, in the aspect of “today, to do them,” and “one who took pains on the eve of the Sabbath,” etc. And therefore Yaakov our father sanctified himself so greatly that he merited during his lifetime that all his journeys were in the aforementioned aspect, in the aspect of Israel’s journeying with the Tabernacle.

qualifiedAfter.en: And certainly, even during Yaakov’s life, all his journeys were in this aspect, in the aspect of the tribes journeying with the Tabernacle. For the main thing is to merit this during one’s lifetime, in the aspect of “today, to do them,” and “one who took pains on the eve of the Sabbath,” etc. And therefore Yaakov our father sanctified himself so greatly that he merited during his lifetime that all his journeys were in the aforementioned aspect, in the aspect of Israel’s journeying with the Tabernacle.

pairs.he: שֶׁזֶּה הַסּוֹד יָדַע יוֹסֵף כִּי יַעֲקֹב מָסַר לוֹ כָּל חָכְמָתוֹ, עַל כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר רָאָה אֶת הָעֲגָלוֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח יוֹסֵף לָשֵׂאת אוֹתוֹ אָז, וַתְּחִי רוּחַ יַעֲקֹב. כִּי הֵבִין שֶׁזֶּה הַסּוֹד אֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ רַק יוֹסֵף, כִּי הוּא סוֹד הָעֲגָלוֹת שֶׁל הַנְּשִׂיאִים שֶׁנָּשְׂאוּ אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן שֶׁכָּל סֵדֶר נְסִיעָתָם עִם הַדְּגָלִים קִבְּלוּ מִיַּעֲקֹב אֲבִיהֶם כַּנַּ״ל. שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַסּוֹד הַזֶּה שֶׁל מַעֲשֵׂה הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְיִשְׂרָאֵל נָשְׂאוּ אוֹתוֹ עִם סֵדֶר הַדְּגָלִים עַל הָעֲגָלוֹת וְהַשְּׁוָרִים וְכוּ׳ עַל יְדֵי כָּל זֶה עִקַּר תִּקּוּן הָאֱמוּנָה לְבַטֵּל חֵטְא הָעֵגֶל שֶׁהוּא פְּגַם הָאֱמוּנָה.
pairs.en: Yosef knew this secret, because Yaakov entrusted all his wisdom to him. Therefore, when he saw the wagons Yosef had sent to carry him, then “the spirit of Yaakov revived.” For he understood that none but Yosef knows this secret. It is the secret of the leaders’ wagons that carried the Tabernacle, whose entire order of journeying with the standards they received from Yaakov their father, as explained above. Through this secret of the work of the Tabernacle, and Israel carrying it with the order of the standards on the wagons and the oxen, etc., through all this comes the essential repair of faith, to nullify the sin of the calf, which is damage to faith.

qualifiedAfter.en: Yosef knew this secret, because Yaakov entrusted all his wisdom to him. It is the secret of the leaders’ wagons that carried the Tabernacle, whose entire order of journeying with the standards they received from Yaakov their father, as explained above. Through this secret of the work of the Tabernacle, and Israel carrying it with the order of the standards on the wagons and the oxen, etc., through all this comes the essential repair of faith, to nullify the sin of the calf, which is damage to faith.

pairs.he: כִּי עַל יְדֵי כָּל הַתִּקּוּנִים שֶׁל הַמִּשְׁכָּן עִם הָעֲגָלוֹת וְכוּ׳ כַּנַּ״ל עַל יְדֵי זֶה מַמְשִׁיכִין שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְמַטָּה בְּקֶשֶׁר אַמִּיץ וְחָזָק שֶׁלֹּא יִנָּתֵק וְלֹא יִהָרֵס לְעוֹלָם שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ עַתָּה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּסוֹף הַגָּלוּת בְּעִקְבוֹת מְשִׁיחָא בִּמְרִירוּת הַמְּרִירוּת גָּלוּת הַנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁל הָעִתִּים הַלָּלוּ אַף עַל פִּי כֵן יָאִירוּ בָּנוּ הַצַּדִּיקֵי אֱמֶת שֶׁנֵּדַע גַּם עַתָּה אֵיךְ לְהִתְחַזֵּק בְּכָל עֵת בִּבְחִינַת וּמִבְּנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר יוֹדְעֵי בִינָה לְעִתִּים לָדַעַת מַה יַּעֲשֶׂה יִשְׂרָאֵל.
pairs.en: For through all the repairs of the Tabernacle with the wagons, etc., as explained above, through this they draw His indwelling presence below with a firm and strong bond that will not be severed and will never be demolished. Thus, even now, at the latter end of these days, at the end of exile, in the footsteps of the Messiah, in the bitterness of the bitterness of the exile of the soul of these times, nevertheless the true righteous ones will shine within us, so that even now we will know how to strengthen ourselves at every time, in the aspect of “And of the children of Yissachar, who understood the times, to know what Israel should do.”

pairs.he: "אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה"
pairs.en: “I shall descend with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring you up.”

qualifiedAfter.en: “I shall descend with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring you up.”

pairs.he: (מ״ו, ד)

זֶה בְּחִינַת מַה שֶּׁהִבְטִיחַ ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ לְיַעֲקֹב ״אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה״, וּמוּבָן בַּסְּפָרִים שֶׁזֶּה הַפָּסוּק מְרַמֵּז כָּל סוֹד גָּלוּת יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעִקַּר הוּא גָּלוּת הַנֶּפֶשׁ, כָּל הָעֲלִיּוֹת וְהַיְרִידוֹת הָעוֹבְרִים עַל אִישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִי, שֶׁזֶּה עִקַּר סוֹד הַגָּלוּת וְהַגְּאֻלָּה. שֶׁהַכֹּל בִּבְחִינַת אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת יְרִידָה תַּכְלִית הָעֲלִיָּה, כַּמּוּבָא.
pairs.en: This is the aspect of what the blessed Lord promised Jacob: “I shall descend with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring you up.” It is understood from the books that this verse alludes to the entire secret of Israel’s exile. Principally, it is the exile of the soul—all the ascents and descents that pass over an Israelite person—which is the principal secret of exile and redemption. Everything is in the aspect of “I shall descend with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring you up,” which is the aspect of a descent whose purpose is ascent, as brought there.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is the aspect of what the blessed Lord promised Jacob: “I shall descend with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring you up.” It is understood from the books that this verse alludes to the entire secret of Israel’s exile. pairs.he: וְהָעִקָּר הוּא הַהִתְחַזְּקוּת, שֶׁצְּרִיכִין לְהִתְחַזֵּק מְאֹד מְאֹד בְּתֹקֶף הִתְגַּבְּרוּת מְרִירוּת הַיְרִידָה עַד שֶׁנִּדְמֶה שֶׁכִּמְעַט כִּמְעַט חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, שֶׁדַּיְקָא מִשָּׁם יְרַחֵם עָלָיו ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיוֹשִׁיעוֹ וִיקָרְבוֹ אֵלָיו, כִּי לֹא יִטֹּשׁ ה׳ אֶת עַמּוֹ וְכוּ׳. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב אִם אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ ה׳ יִסְעָדֵנִי וְכוּ׳. וּכְתִיב וָאֹמַר אָבַד נִצְחִי וְתוֹחַלְתִּי מֵה׳ זֹאת אָשִׁיב אֶל לִבִּי עַל כֵּן אוֹחִיל חַסְדֵי ה׳ כִּי לֹא תָמְנוּ כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמָיו חֲדָשִׁים לַבְּקָרִים וְכוּ׳ וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: The principal thing is strengthening oneself: one must strengthen oneself very, very much amid the intense increase of the bitterness of descent, until it seems that it is almost, almost—Heaven forbid. Precisely from there the blessed Lord will have compassion upon him, save him, and bring him near to Him, for “The Lord will not forsake His people,” etc. As it is written, “If I said: My foot has slipped, Your kindness, Lord, will support me,” etc. And it is written, “And I said: My endurance and my hope from the Lord have perished. This I shall bring back to my heart; therefore I shall hope. The kindnesses of the Lord, for we have not ended, for His mercies have not ceased; new each morning,” etc., and as stated above.

This I shall bring back to my heart; therefore I shall hope. The kindnesses of the Lord, for we have not ended, for His mercies have not ceased; new each morning,” etc., and as stated above.

pairs.he: וְכֵן בִּפְסוּקִים רַבִּים וּבִפְרָט בְּדִבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה מְבֹאָר שֶׁדַּיְקָא כְּשֶׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵם בְּתַכְלִית הַהִתְרַחֲקוּת וְהַצָּרָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, אָז דַּיְקָא יֵשׁ סֵבֶר וְתִקְוָה לִישׁוּעָה גְּדוֹלָה. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בַּמִּדְרָשׁ עַל פָּסוּק וְעָלָה מִן הָאָרֶץ דַּיְקָא, עַיֵּן שָׁם. וְכֵן הוּא בִּפְרָטִיּוּת בְּכָל אָדָם וּבְכָל זְמַן. כִּי ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ מְהַפֵּךְ הַמַּכָּה לִרְפוּאָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה וְכָל זֶה מְרֻמָּז בַּפָּסוּק אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד.
pairs.en: Likewise, in many verses, and particularly in the words of our rabbis, of blessed memory, it is explained that precisely when Israel is at the utmost distance and distress, Heaven forbid, precisely then there is expectation and hope for a great salvation. As explained in the Midrash concerning the verse “And he will ascend from the land”—precisely; see there. It is likewise so in particular with every person and at every time. For the blessed Lord turns the blow into a remedy, as our rabbis, of blessed memory, said. All this is alluded to in the verse “I shall descend.”

qualifiedAfter.en: Likewise, in many verses, and particularly in the words of our rabbis, of blessed memory, it is explained that precisely when Israel is at the utmost distance and distress, Heaven forbid, precisely then there is expectation and hope for a great salvation. As explained in the Midrash concerning the verse “And he will ascend from the land”—precisely; see there. It is likewise so in particular with every person and at every time. For the blessed Lord turns the blow into a remedy, as our rabbis, of blessed memory, said. All this is alluded to in the verse “I shall descend.”

pairs.he: רְמָזוּ שֵׁם קָדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹצֵא מִפְּסוּקִים אֵלּוּ וּלְבָאֵר הַדָּבָר יוֹתֵר, כִּי אִיתָא שֶׁיֵּשׁ שֵׁם שֶׁיּוֹצֵא מִפָּסוּק זֶה, אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ מִצְרַיְמָה, כַּמּוּבָא בַּתְּפִלּוֹת שֶׁבְּסֵפֶר שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן וּבַתְּפִלּוֹת שֶׁאוֹמְרִים בְּלֵיל הוֹשַׁעְנָא רַבָּה אַחַר תְּהִלִּים שֶׁתִּקְּנוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ וּלְהִתְפַּלֵּל לְהִנָּצֵל מִכָּל מִינֵי צָרוֹת בְּכֹחַ הַשֵּׁם הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַיּוֹצֵא מִפָּסוּק זֶה, אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ וְכוּ׳ שֶׁהוּא אמ״י וְכוּ׳, עַיֵּן שָׁם. וְעִנְיַן יְצִיאַת הַשֵּׁם הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה הוּא כָּךְ, כִּי בְּפָסוּק זֶה יֵשׁ שְׁלֹשִׁים אוֹתִיּוֹת מִן ״אָנֹכִי״ עַד ״גַם עָלֹה״, וּמְחַלְּקִים אוֹתָם לִשְׁלֹשָׁה חֲלָקִים שֶׁל יוּד יוּד יוּד אוֹתִיּוֹת, דְּהַיְנוּ ״אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ״ הוּא יוּד אוֹתִיּוֹת, וְכֵן ״מִצְרַיְמָה״ ״וְאָנֹכִי״ עַד הַיּוּד שֶׁל ״וְאָנֹכִי״ הֵם יוּד אוֹתִיּוֹת, וְאַחַר כָּךְ הַיּוּד שֶׁל ״וְאָנֹכִי״ וּתֵבוֹת שֶׁלְּאַחֲרָיו ״אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה״ הֵם יוּד אוֹתִיּוֹת, וּמְחַבְּרִין אוֹת אַחַת מִכָּל חֵלֶק וְחֵלֶק מִשְּׁלֹשָׁה חֲלָקִים הַנַּ״ל וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יוֹצֵא הַשֵּׁם הַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: They alluded to a holy Name that emerges from these verses. To explain the matter further: it is stated that there is a Name that emerges from this verse, “I shall descend with you to Egypt,” as brought in the prayers in the book Shaaray Tziyon and in the prayers said on the night of Hoashanuh Rabbuh after Psalms. They ordained requesting and praying to be saved from all kinds of troubles through the power of the holy Name that emerges from this verse, “I shall descend with you,” etc., which is אמ״י, etc.; see there. The manner in which this holy Name emerges is as follows: in this verse there are thirty letters from “אָנֹכִי” through “גַם עָלֹה,” and they divide them into three parts of ten, ten, ten letters. That is, “אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ” is ten letters. Likewise, “מִצְרַיְמָה” and “וְאָנֹכִי,” up to the yud of “וְאָנֹכִי,” are ten letters. Then the yud of “וְאָנֹכִי” and the words after it, “אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה,” are ten letters. They join one letter from each and every part of the three aforesaid parts, and through this the aforesaid Name emerges.

qualifiedAfter.en: They alluded to a holy Name that emerges from these verses. To explain the matter further: it is stated that there is a Name that emerges from this verse, “I shall descend with you to Egypt,” as brought in the prayers in the book Shaaray Tziyon and in the prayers said on the night of Hoashanuh Rabbuh after Psalms. They ordained requesting and praying to be saved from all kinds of troubles through the power of the holy Name that emerges from this verse, “I shall descend with you,” etc., which is אמ״י, etc.; see there. The manner in which this holy Name emerges is as follows: in this verse there are thirty letters from “אָנֹכִי” through “גַם עָלֹה,” and they divide them into three parts of ten, ten, ten letters. That is, “אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ” is ten letters. Likewise, “מִצְרַיְמָה” and “וְאָנֹכִי,” up to the yud of “וְאָנֹכִי,” are ten letters. Then the yud of “וְאָנֹכִי” and the words after it, “אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה,” are ten letters. They join one letter from each and every part of the three aforesaid parts, and through this the aforesaid Name emerges.

pairs.he: דְּהַיְנוּ הָאָלֶף שֶׁל ״אָנֹכִי״ וְהַמֵּם שֶׁל ״מִצְרַיְמָה״ וְהַיּוּד שֶׁל ״וְאָנֹכִי״ הַנַּ״ל וְיוֹצֵא הַשֵּׁם אמי. וְכֵן אַחַר כָּךְ הַנּוּן שֶׁל ״אָנֹכִי״ וְהַצַּדִּי שֶׁל ״מִצְרַיְמָה״ וְהָאָלֶף שֶׁל ״אַעַלְךָ״. וְכֵן כֻּלָּם. וְהַסֵּדֶר הוּא כָּךְ (אנכי ארד עמך מצרימה ואנכי אעלך גם עלה).
pairs.en: That is, the alef of “אָנֹכִי,” the mem of “מִצְרַיְמָה,” and the yud of the aforesaid “וְאָנֹכִי,” and the Name אמי emerges. Likewise, afterward, the nun of “אָנֹכִי,” the tzadi of “מִצְרַיְמָה,” and the alef of “אַעַלְךָ.” And likewise all of them. The order is thus (אנכי ארד עמך מצרימה ואנכי אעלך גם עלה).

qualifiedAfter.en: That is, the alef of “אָנֹכִי,” the mem of “מִצְרַיְמָה,” and the yud of the aforesaid “וְאָנֹכִי,” and the Name אמי emerges. Likewise, afterward, the nun of “אָנֹכִי,” the tzadi of “מִצְרַיְמָה,” and the alef of “אַעַלְךָ.” And likewise all of them. The order is thus (אנכי ארד עמך מצרימה ואנכי אעלך גם עלה).

pairs.he: וְהַמֵּשִׂים לֵב יוּכַל לְהָבִין מִזֶּה רְמָזִים נִפְלָאִים לְעִנְיָן הַנַּ״ל לְהִתְחַזֵּק תָּמִיד לִהְיוֹת מְצַפֶּה לִישׁוּעָה גְּדוֹלָה בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹר עָלָיו, כִּי יֵשׁ בַּפָּסוּק הַזֶּה שְׁלֹשָׁה חֲלָקִים שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת הַיְרִידָה לְתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת, וְהַגָּלוּת בְּעַצְמָהּ, וְהָעֲלִיָּה מִתּוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת שְׁלֹשָׁה חֲלָקִים, שֶׁהֵם אָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַיְרִידָה לְתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת. וּצְרִיכִין לֵידַע וּלְהַאֲמִין שֶׁגַּם בְּעֵת הַיְרִידָה בְּעַצְמָהּ ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ עִמּוֹ בִּבְחִינַת אָנֹכִי בְּעַצְמִי, כִּבְיָכוֹל, אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ. וְאַחַר כָּךְ הַחֵלֶק הַשֵּׁנִי הוּא מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי עַד הַיּוּד, לְרַמֵּז עַל הַגָּלוּת בְּעַצְמָהּ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מִצְרַיְמָה שֶׁכּוֹלֵל כָּל הַגָּלֻיּוֹת. וְתֵכֶף כְּשֶׁבָּאִים בְּתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת שֶׁהוּא הַיְרִידָה, תֵּכֶף מַתְחִיל הָעֲלִיָּה וְעַל כֵּן נִכְתַּב מִיָּד, וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ.
pairs.en: One who pays attention can understand from this wondrous allusions concerning the aforesaid matter: to strengthen oneself always to anticipate great salvation through whatever may pass over him. For there are three parts in this verse, which are the aspect of the descent into exile, the exile itself, and the ascent from exile. This is the aspect of three parts, which are “I shall descend with you,” which is the aspect of the descent into exile. One must know and believe that even at the time of the descent itself the blessed Lord is with him, in the aspect of “I Myself, as it were, shall descend with you.” Then the second part is “מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי” up to the yud, to allude to the exile itself, which is the aspect of Egypt, comprising all the exiles. Immediately when one comes into the exile, which is the descent, the ascent immediately begins; therefore it is written at once, “And I shall bring you up.”

pairs.he: נִמְצָא שֶׁאָנֹכִי הָרִאשׁוֹן מְרַמֵּז עַל הַיְרִידָה לְתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת, וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי מְרַמֵּז עַל הָעֲלִיָּה מִתּוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת, אַךְ בִּשְׁעַת הַגָּלוּת וְהַיְרִידָה כְּשֶׁמַּתְחִיל צְמִיחַת קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ מִבְּחִינַת וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הָעֲלִיָּה בְּחִינַת וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ וְכוּ׳, אֲזַי הַבַּעַל דָּבָר רוֹצֶה לְהִתְגַּבֵּר בְּיוֹתֵר, כְּדֶרֶךְ שְׁנֵי אֲנָשִׁים הַנִּלְחָמִים זֶה בָּזֶה שֶׁכְּשֶׁרוֹאֶה שֶׁהָאֶחָד מִתְגַּבֵּר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ אֲזַי הוּא מִתְחַזֵּק כְּנֶגְדּוֹ בְּהִתְגַּבְּרוּת וְהִתְגַּבְּרוּת יוֹתֵר, כַּמּוּבָא בִּדְבָרֵינוּ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים וְזֶה עִקַּר תֹּקֶף מְרִירוּת הַגָּלוּת שֶׁל עַכְשָׁו מֵחֲמַת שֶׁהוּא עַכְשָׁו בְּעִקְבוֹת מְשִׁיחָא וְה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ מְצַפֶּה בְּכָל יוֹם לְמַהֵר לְגָאֳלֵנוּ, עַל כֵּן מִתְגַּבֵּר בְּיוֹתֵר בִּכְלָל וּבִפְרָט כַּיָּדוּעַ.
pairs.en: It follows that the first “I” alludes to the descent into exile, and the second “I” alludes to ascent from exile. But at the time of exile and descent, when the sprouting of the horn of salvation begins—which is drawn from the aspect of the second “And I,” which is the aspect of ascent, the aspect of “And I shall bring you up,” etc.—then the adversary wishes to overpower all the more. It is as with two people fighting one another: when one sees that the other is gaining strength against him, he then strengthens himself against him with greater and greater exertion, as brought in our words several times. This is the principal intensity of the bitterness of the present exile, because now it is at the heels of the Messiah, and the blessed Lord anticipates each day hastening to redeem us; therefore the adversary gains strength all the more, in general and in particular, as is known.

pairs.he: וְזֶה מְרֻמָּז בְּסוֹד הַשֵּׁם שֶׁל הַפָּסוּק הַנַּ״ל שֶׁמְּרַמֵּז עַל כָּל הַגָּלֻיּוֹת וּגְאֻלָּתָם בִּכְלָל וּבִפְרָט כַּנַּ״ל, כִּי הַחֵלֶק הַשֵּׁנִי הוּא מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי עַד הַיּוּד הָאַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁל וְאָנֹכִי, כִּי וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי הוּא בְּחִינַת הַתִּקְוָה לִישׁוּעָה בְּחִינַת וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה, אַךְ תֵּכֶף כְּשֶׁמַּתְחִיל בְּתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת צְמִיחַת קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ מִן וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי, אֲזַי הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא וְהַבַּעַל דָּבָר מִתְגַּבְּרִין לְהַעְלִים גַּם זֹאת וְרוֹצִים לִתְפֹּס גַּם בְּחִינַת זֹאת לְתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת בְּסוֹד גָּלוּת הַשְּׁכִינָה, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת שֶׁאוֹתִיּוֹת הָאֶמְצָעִיִּים הֵם ״מִצְרַיְמָה״ ״וְאָנֹכִי״, כִּי גָּלוּת מִצְרַיִם שֶׁכּוֹלֵל כָּל הַגָּלֻיּוֹת רוֹצֶה לְהִתְגַּבֵּר גַּם עַל וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי לְהַעְלִים הַצְּמִיחַת קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה שֶׁנִּמְשָׁךְ מִשָּׁם.
pairs.en: This is alluded to in the secret of the Name of the aforesaid verse, which alludes to all the exiles and their redemption, in general and in particular, as stated above. For the second part is “מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי” up to the final yud of “וְאָנֹכִי”; for the second “And I” is the aspect of hope for salvation, the aspect of “And I shall also bring you up.” But immediately when the sprouting of the horn of salvation begins within the exile, which is drawn from the second “And I,” then the other side and the adversary gain strength to conceal this too. They wish to seize this aspect too into the exile, in the secret of the exile of the Divine Presence. This is the aspect of the middle letters being “מִצְרַיְמָה” and “וְאָנֹכִי,” for the Egyptian exile, which comprises all the exiles, wishes to gain strength even against the second “And I,” to conceal the sprouting of the horn of salvation that is drawn from there.

pairs.he: וּמִגֹּדֶל הִתְגַּבְּרוּתָם מְאֹד מְאֹד עַד שֶׁמַּעֲלִימִין וּמַסְתִּירִין הַכֹּל הָיָה כִּמְעַט אֶפֶס תִּקְוָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, לוּלֵא ה׳ עֶזְרָתָה לָנוּ שֶׁכְּשֶׁמִּתְפַּשְּׁטִין בְּיוֹתֵר עַל הַקְּדֻשָּׁה וְרוֹצִים לְהַעְלִים לְגַמְרֵי בִּבְחִינַת צוֹפֶה רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וּמְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ, אֲזַי דַּיְקָא ה׳ לֹא יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמְּבֹאָר בְּסִימָן רז עַל פָּסוּק זֶה, עַיֵּן שָׁם מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב, שֶׁהַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא וְהַחוֹלְקִים רוֹצִים לְהִתְפַּשֵּׁט לִתְפֹּס הַצַּדִּיק לְגַמְרֵי וְכוּ׳ עַד שֶׁלֹּא יוּכַל לְהַנְשִׁים חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, אֲבָל ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ לֹא יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ.
pairs.en: Because of their exceedingly, exceedingly great increase of strength, until they conceal and hide everything, there would have been almost no hope, Heaven forbid, had the Lord not come to our aid. When they spread themselves still more against holiness and wish to conceal it completely, in the aspect of “The wicked watches the righteous man and seeks to put him to death,” precisely then “The Lord will not abandon him into his hand.” As explained in section רז concerning this verse: see there what is written, that the other side and the opponents wish to spread themselves to seize the righteous man completely, etc., until he cannot take breath, Heaven forbid. But the blessed Lord will not abandon him into his hand.

But the blessed Lord will not abandon him into his hand.

pairs.he: וְזֶה סוֹד הַיּוּד הָאַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁל וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי, שֶׁהִיא שַׁיָּכָה לְהַחֵלֶק הַשְּׁלִישִׁי הַמִּצְטָרֵף לְתֵבוֹת אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה. לְרַמֵּז שֶׁכְּשֶׁמִּתְפַּשְּׁטִים גַּם עַל וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי וְרוֹצִים לְהַעְלִים הַצְּמִיחַת קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה הַנִּמְשָׁךְ מִשָּׁם כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּשְׁתַּקְּעוּ בְּגָלוּתָם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, אֲבָל ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ לֹא יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדָם, כִּי יָדוֹ אוֹחֶזֶת בַּעֲקֵב עֵשָׂו כְּתִיב. וּפֵרֵשׁ רַשִׁ״י שֶׁאֵינוֹ מַסְפִּיק לִגְמֹר מַלְכוּתוֹ עַד שֶׁיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב וְנוֹטְלָהּ הֵימֶנּוּ, כִּי הַיּוּד שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת הַיּוּד הָאַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁל וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי הַנַּ״ל, כְּשֶׁרוֹצִים לְהִתְגַּבֵּר וּלְהִתְפַּשֵּׁט גַּם עָלֶיהָ חַס וְשָׁלוֹם לְהַעְלִים הַכֹּל חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, אֲזַי זֹאת הַיּוּד מִתְגַּבֶּרֶת וּמִצְטָרֶפֶת לְתֵבַת אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה, שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לַעֲלִיָּה גְּדוֹלָה וְכַנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: This is the secret of the final yud of the second “וְאָנֹכִי,” which belongs to the third part and joins the words “אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה.” It alludes to this: when they extend themselves also over the second “And I,” and wish to conceal the sprouting of the horn of salvation drawn from there so that they will become submerged in their exile, Heaven forbid, the blessed Lord will nevertheless not abandon him into their hand. For it is written, “His hand grips Esau’s heel.” Rashi explained that he does not have time to finish his kingship before Jacob comes and takes it from him. For the yud of Jacob, which is the aspect of the final yud of the aforesaid second “וְאָנֹכִי”—when they wish to gain strength and extend themselves even over it, Heaven forbid, to conceal everything, Heaven forbid—then this yud gains strength and joins the expression “אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה,” through which everything is transformed into a great ascent, as stated above.

qualifiedAfter.en: This is the secret of the final yud of the second “וְאָנֹכִי,” which belongs to the third part and joins the words “אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה.” It alludes to this: when they extend themselves also over the second “And I,” and wish to conceal the sprouting of the horn of salvation drawn from there so that they will become submerged in their exile, Heaven forbid, the blessed Lord will nevertheless not abandon him into their hand. pairs.he: וְהָבֵן הַדָּבָר הֵיטֵב, כִּי אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁמְּחַלְּקִים הַפָּסוּק לִשְׁלֹשָׁה חֲלָקִים כַּנַּ״ל, שֶׁהֵם הַיְרִידָה לְתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת וְהַגָּלוּת בְּעַצְמוֹ וְהָעֲלִיָּה מִתּוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת, אֲבָל בֶּאֱמֶת הַכֹּל נִכְלָל בִּשְׁתֵּי בְּחִינוֹת. כִּי תֵכֶף כְּשֶׁבָּאִים בְּתוֹךְ הַגָּלוּת תֵּכֶף מַתְחִיל צְמִיחַת קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה, כִּי מַתְחִיל מִיָּד הָעֲלִיָּה. שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת מִלּוּי פְּגִימַת הַלְּבָנָה שֶׁתֵּכֶף כְּשֶׁבָּאָה לְתַכְלִית הַמִּעוּט מַתְחֶלֶת לְהִתְמַלֹּאות מִיָּד, שֶׁזֶּה מְרַמֵּז עַל הַגְּאֻלָּה מִתּוֹךְ תֹּקֶף הַגָּלוּת כַּיָּדוּעַ. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב כִּי יִרְאֶה כִּי אָזְלַת יָד וְאֶפֶס עָצוּר וְעָזוּב וְכוּ׳ רְאוּ עַתָּה כִּי אֲנִי אֲנִי הוּא וְכוּ׳.
pairs.en: Understand the matter well: although the verse is divided into three parts, as stated above—the descent into exile, the exile itself, and the ascent from exile—in truth, everything is included in two aspects. Immediately when one comes into exile, the sprouting of the horn of salvation begins immediately, for the ascent begins at once. This is the aspect of filling the moon’s deficiency: immediately when it comes to the utmost diminution, it begins at once to fill. This alludes to redemption from the intensity of exile, as is known. As it is written, “For He will see that strength has departed, and that there is none confined or free,” etc., “See now that I, I am He,” etc.

Immediately when one comes into exile, the sprouting of the horn of salvation begins immediately, for the ascent begins at once. This alludes to redemption from the intensity of exile, as is known. pairs.he: וּבֶאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ הַכֹּל אֶחָד, כִּי הַיְרִידָה בְּעַצְמָהּ הִיא הָעֲלִיָּה בִּבְחִינַת יְרִידָה תַּכְלִית הָעֲלִיָּה, אַךְ עִקַּר הַגָּלוּת הוּא גָּלוּת הַדַּעַת שֶׁרוֹצָה לְהַסְתִּיר וּלְהַעְלִים הַדַּעַת לְגַמְרֵי כְּאִלּוּ אֶפֶס תִּקְוָה חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרֶצַח בְּעַצְמוֹתַי חֵרְפוּנִי צוֹרְרָי בְּאָמְרָם אֵלַי כָּל הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹקֶיךָ וְכוּ׳. וְכֵן בִּפְסוּקִים הַרְבֵּה, עַד שֶׁרוֹצִים לְהַעְלִים גַּם וְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁהוּא הַתְחָלַת צְמִיחַת קֶרֶן יְשׁוּעָה כַּנַּ״ל, אֲבָל כְּשֶׁרוֹצֶה לְהַעְלִים וּלְהַסְתִּיר לְגַמְרֵי ה׳ לֹא יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ, כִּי הַיּוּד הָאַחֲרוֹנָה שֶׁבְּוְאָנֹכִי הַשֵּׁנִי מִתְגַּבֶּרֶת וּמִצְטָרֶפֶת עִם תֵּבוֹת אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה וְנִתְהַפֵּךְ הַכֹּל לַעֲלִיָּה גְּדוֹלָה כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: In very truth everything is one, for the descent itself is the ascent, in the aspect of a descent whose purpose is ascent. But the principal exile is the exile of knowledge, which wishes to hide and conceal knowledge completely, as though there were no hope, Heaven forbid, as it is written, “With murder in my bones my foes have taunted me, saying to me all day: Where is your God?” etc. Likewise in many verses, until they wish to conceal even the second “And I,” which is the beginning of the sprouting of the horn of salvation, as stated above. But when he wishes to conceal and hide it completely, the Lord will not abandon him into his hand; for the final yud in the second “וְאָנֹכִי” gains strength and joins the words “אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה,” and everything is transformed into a great ascent, as stated above.

But the principal exile is the exile of knowledge, which wishes to hide and conceal knowledge completely, as though there were no hope, Heaven forbid, as it is written, “With murder in my bones my foes have taunted me, saying to me all day: Where is your God?” etc. Likewise in many verses, until they wish to conceal even the second “And I,” which is the beginning of the sprouting of the horn of salvation, as stated above. pairs.he: כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת הַכֹּל לְהֵפֶךְ, כִּי ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ עִמּוֹ תָּמִיד בֵּין בְּעֵת הַיְרִידָה בֵּין בְּהַגָּלוּת בְּעַצְמוֹ בֵּין בְּעֵת הָעֲלִיָּה כִּמְפֹרָשׁ בַּפָּסוּק זֶה בְּעַצְמוֹ, וְאָנֹכִי אֵרֵד עִמְּךָ מִצְרַיְמָה וְאָנֹכִי אַעַלְךָ וְכוּ׳. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב, אִתִּי מִלְּבָנוֹן כַּלָּה אִתִּי מִלְּבָנוֹן תָּבוֹאִי וְכוּ׳. וְעַיֵּן פֵּרוּשׁ רַשִׁ״י שָׁם שֶׁפֵּרֵשׁ מַה שֶּׁלֹּא כְּתִיב אִתִּי לַלְּבָנוֹן תָּבוֹאִי, לוֹמַר, מִשְּׁעַת יְצִיאַתְכֶם מִכָּאן, עַד שְׁעַת בִּיאָתְכֶם לְכָאן אֲנִי עִמָּכֶם בְּכָל אֲשֶׁר תֵּצְאוּ וְתָבוֹאוּ, הַיְנוּ כַּנַּ״ל וְהָבֵן הֵיטֵב.
pairs.en: For in truth everything is the opposite: the blessed Lord is with him always, whether at the time of descent, in the exile itself, or at the time of ascent, as expressly stated in this very verse: “And I shall descend with you to Egypt, and I shall bring you up,” etc. As it is written, “With Me from Lebanon, bride, with Me from Lebanon you shall come,” etc. Examine Rashi’s commentary there, where he explained why it is not written “With Me to Lebanon you shall come”: to say, from the time of your departure from here until the time of your coming here, I am with you wherever you go out and come in. That is, as stated above; understand well.

qualifiedAfter.en: For in truth everything is the opposite: the blessed Lord is with him always, whether at the time of descent, in the exile itself, or at the time of ascent, as expressly stated in this very verse: “And I shall descend with you to Egypt, and I shall bring you up,” etc. As it is written, “With Me from Lebanon, bride, with Me from Lebanon you shall come,” etc. Examine Rashi’s commentary there, where he explained why it is not written “With Me to Lebanon you shall come”: to say, from the time of your departure from here until the time of your coming here, I am with you wherever you go out and come in. That is, as stated above; understand well.

pairs.he: וְאִם תְּדַקְדֵּק יוֹתֵר תִּרְאֶה נִפְלָאוֹת, כִּי הֲלֹא הַיּוּד שֶׁל וְאָנֹכִי הַנַּ״ל שֶׁהִיא מִצְטָרֶפֶת לְתֵבַת אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה שֶׁמִּשָּׁם עִקַּר הָעֲלִיָּה, כִּי הוּא שֶׁעָמְדָה לָנוּ וְלַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּגָלוּתֵנוּ שֶׁאֵינָהּ מַנַּחַת שֶׁתִּתְפַּשֵּׁט הַסִּטְרָא אַחֲרָא גַּם עָלֶיהָ וְכוּ׳ וְכַנַּ״ל, זֹאת הַיּוּד בְּעַצְמָהּ מִצְטָרֶפֶת בְּהַשֵּׁם הָרִאשׁוֹן הַיּוֹצֵא מִפָּסוּק זֶה שֶׁהוּא אמ״י, שֶׁהוּא הָאָלֶף שֶׁל ״אָנֹכִי״ הָרִאשׁוֹן וְהַמֵּם שֶׁל ״מִצְרַיְמָה״ וְהַיּוּד הַזֹּאת הַנַּ״ל כַּנַּ״ל.
pairs.en: If you examine more closely, you will see wonders. For surely the yud of the aforesaid “וְאָנֹכִי,” which joins the expression “אַעַלְךָ גַם עָלֹה,” from which comes the principal ascent—for it is what stood by us and our forefathers in our exile, not allowing the other side to spread even over it, etc., as stated above—this very yud joins in the first Name that emerges from this verse, which is אמ״י: the alef of the first “אָנֹכִי,” the mem of “מִצְרַיְמָה,” and this aforesaid yud, as stated above.
